scope: Refresh the existing HATCH pattern-retention and transformed-phase comparator boundary using primary DXF references, a recent independent peer report, current peer source, and the newly published peer release artifact.

method.kind: Read-only primary documentation, package-release metadata, peer issue/source review, and local plan reconciliation
method.evidenceBoundary: Autodesk references establish the documented DXF field vocabulary and repeated pattern-line structure, not every consumer's transform behavior. Issue #1402 contains reporter-provided peer reproduction and plot-comparison claims that were not reproduced here. Current mutable ezdxf master source contains a translation-aware base-point transform and an explicit non-uniform-scale limitation, but this does not establish the contents or behavior of the exact 1.4.5 release artifact.

observed: HATCH is defined with OCS elevation and optional extrusion direction, boundary path data, and a counted sequence of pattern-definition lines.
Each pattern line includes angle (53), base point components (43/44), offset components (45/46), dash count (79), and repeated dash lengths (49).
doesNotEstablish: A universal consumer transform algorithm for preserving visual pattern phase
That boundary-coordinate equality implies pattern-base equality or equivalent hatch appearance
evidence.planUse: Keep local raw/typed HATCH field retention separate from consumer transform calibration.

observed: The issue author reports ezdxf 1.4.4 and 1.4.5b0 moving boundary paths under translation without moving pattern-line base points.
The issue was closed by PR #1407, merged into master on 2026-08-19 as c111eef0; the PR maps original pattern base points through the full OCS transform after existing scale/rotation handling.

The plan already records a six-case controlled run against ezdxf 1.4.4 dd7f6cc3: four discrepancies and two positive controls. The PR reports three focused upstream regression tests and 195 passed/3 skipped in its pattern-related suite; those upstream results are not new local runs.
The issue author reports an AutoCAD plot comparison and a 1,254-window A/B result; neither was independently reproduced in this research turn.
doesNotEstablish: A normative DXF requirement beyond the cited field definitions
A verified result for ezdxf 1.4.5 release
evidence.planUse: Treat the issue as corroboration of the existing ezdxf 1.4.4 calibration, not an open peer bug or a new local finding. Do not repeat the six-case 1.4.4 matrix.

observed: The inspected DXFPolygon.transform source captures original pattern base points, applies scale/rotation to pattern lines, then transforms the original base points through the full OCS transform.
PR #1407 identifies translation as its own change and points to prior rotation and scaling fixes; the inspected implementation explicitly marks non-uniform pattern scaling unsupported.
doesNotEstablish: Behavior of a released or locally executed artifact
Support for non-uniform scale or reflection
evidence.planUse: Treat mutable master as source-level calibration only. The exact ezdxf 1.4.5 release artifact is a separate, not-yet-verified question.

nextActions: Reuse the integrated 7AH.pattern-retention and six-case ezdxf 1.4.4 calibration; do not rerun them for this plan refresh.

At the existing composed optional comparator checkpoint only, if ezdxf 1.4.5 is already available, bind the source archive hash and inspect the exact transform implementation. If a runtime check is warranted, run only translation and combined rotation/translation with analytic OCS expectations for boundary and pattern base points.

Keep non-uniform-scale/reflection out of qualified cases, mark unobservable phase NOT_OBSERVABLE, and record unavailable exact-release checks as NOT_RUN. Do not install a peer during an implementation slice.
